definitions.explanation: The taste of salt, or a seasoning style based primarily on salt rather than soy sauce, miso, or other flavorings.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{塩味|しおみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{塩味|しおみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: This soup doesn't have enough saltiness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧なら、⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{塩味|しおみ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}する→調理する：26793_chourisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: If you want to bring out the natural flavor of the ingredients, the best approach is to cook with just salt seasoning.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) and {味|み} (taste/flavor). In the context of ramen and other dishes, {塩味|しおみ} refers to a salt-based broth or seasoning style, as opposed to ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (soy sauce flavor), ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (miso flavor), or ⟦{豚骨|とんこつ}→豚骨：17669_tonkotsu⟧ (pork bone broth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩味|しおみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧: salt-flavored ramen
- {塩味|しおみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いている→効く：01932_kiku⟧: has a good amount of salt flavor
- {塩味|しおみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not salty enough
- {塩味|しおみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: too salty
- {塩味|しおみ}⟦ベース→ベース：08762_beesu⟧: salt-based (seasoning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {塩味|しおあじ}: saltiness — same kanji, alternative reading; しおあじ focuses more on the taste sensation, while しおみ is used more as a seasoning category
- ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧: salt content — the amount of salt in food; a nutritional/health term
- ⟦{塩辛|しおから}い→塩辛い：02522_shiokarai⟧: salty (adjective) — describes food that has too much salt
